Brave assaulter
builds.desc:
This build aims to take Thea's above average Atk and Def stats and skyrocket them to absurd heights by stacking Brazen effects. The goal is to bring her HP down to the 75% HP threshold to activate Brazen Atk/Def, giving her upwards to +14 to both stats or +10 on player phase when opting to use Sturdy Blow. Sturdy Blow is an effective alternative as it allows Thea to still gain stat bonuses even at full health and lets her damage be more consistent.
With a Brave Lance the effects of the stat bonuses are effectively doubled, potentially even quadrupled if quadding with the Brash Assault variant. Bonfire takes advantage of extra defense for true damage while Galeforce can be used with Brash Assault. Chill Def helps Thea secure kills by herself or she can opt for Brash Assault to try and quadruple attack enemies at low HP. When going for quads it may be recommended to utilize Brazen Atk/Res 3 so that Thea can be more flexible in attack enemies so she doesn't get crushed by dragons or magic users.
